<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def Npos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
    return None
# red=train, blue=boxB fixed. Sweep all 9 player positions, check win each step.
seq = ['RIGHT','RIGHT','UP','LEFT','LEFT','UP','RIGHT','RIGHT']
print("start:", Npos(current_frame))
for d in seq:
    action([d])
    w = last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed')
    print(d, "-> N:", Npos(current_frame), "WIN?" , w)
    if w: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
